title: Chinese Historical Rulers Corpus — Canonical Master
purpose: Canonical denominator for all rulers to research/distill; never infer completeness from existing skills.

required: highest decision-maker of a politically autonomous entity or competing central government
observable actual rule/control rather than pure posthumous honor or unsupported claim
default_exclusions: purely posthumous rulers with no rule episode
claimants with no observable governing entity
legendary rulers unless separately tagged legendary
ordinary regional warlords without sovereign/central-government rule episode
inclusion_rule.low_evidence_policy: Keep qualifying rulers in master but mark LIMITED-EVIDENCE; never fabricate mental models to fill quota.

corpus_layers.CORE: qualifying sovereign/highest rulers under the common rule
corpus_layers.EXTENDED: borderline autonomous regimes or analytically valuable non-core rulers
corpus_layers.LEGENDARY: traditional/legendary rulers kept separate from historical completion rate

polities: 战国主要诸侯国（含战国七雄及满足统一准入规则者）
具有竞争性中央政府性质的广州政权

explicit_boundary_examples.note: qualifies through Beijing-government supreme-rule episode, not ordinary warlord status

completion_rule: CORE completion = matched existing/distilled CORE persons / all CORE persons. Episodes never duplicate a person.
next_build_step: Enumerate every person per polity, normalize aliases, then match against data/corpus-registry.json and skills/*/*-perspective.
